caption: A ball rolls across a living-room floor, disappears behind a sofa, and comes out the other side.

sa.check: A ball rolls across a living-room floor.
It comes out the other side.
The roll in comes first and the emergence follows.

pc.expect: The same ball reappears at the far side, not changed, doubled, or from the wrong side.
pc.fail: A different ball emerges; or two balls come out; or it emerges from the side it entered; or nothing comes out and a ball appears elsewhere.

pc.expect: It reappears at about the time and speed its motion implies, continuing the same line.
pc.fail: It emerges instantly; or long after it should; or emerges going the other way.

pc.expect: The ball is hidden by the sofa and is not visible through it.
pc.fail: It shows through the sofa; or passes through the sofa's front; or the sofa passes through the ball.

pc.expect: It rolls straight and slows gently.
pc.fail: It curves on the open floor; or speeds up; or stops and restarts.

pc.expect: The ball and the sofa keep their shape.
pc.fail: The ball turns into another object; or the sofa changes shape; or the ball merges with the sofa.

pc.expect: The ball's colour and the room stay the same.
pc.fail: The ball changes colour; or the sofa changes; or the room rearranges.
